profile.info_excerpt:
Sounio Compiler (souc)
Version: 1.0.0-beta.4
Commit: unknown-dirty
Build date: 2026-02-26

Host:
  Target: x86_64
  OS: linux
  Family: unix

Language Features:
  - Algebraic effects with handlers
  - Linear and affine types (resource safety)
  - Units of measure (dimensional analysis)
  - Refinement types (SMT-backed verification)
  - Epistemic types (confidence, provenance, ontology)
  - GPU-native computation (CUDA/Metal)

Enabled Backends:
  [-] LLVM - rebuild with --features llvm
  [-] Cranelift JIT - rebuild with --features jit
  [+] GPU codegen - PTX/SPIR-V generation

Enabled Features:
  [-] SMT Solver - rebuild with --features smt
  [-] LSP Server - rebuild with --features lsp
  [-] Ontology - rebuild with --features ontology
  [-] Distributed builds - rebuild with --features distributed
  [-] Package manager - rebuild with --features pkg

Build with all feature groups: use your selected build profile configuration.

For more information: https://sounio-lang.org
Report bugs: https://github.com/sounio-lang/sounio/issues
profile.build_help_excerpt:
Build a Sounio source file to native executable (requires --features llvm)

Usage: souc-linux-x86_64-gpu build [OPTIONS] <FILE>

Arguments:
  <FILE>
          Input file

Options:
  -o, --output <FILE>
          Output file

      --backend <BACKEND>
          Backend to use (native, llvm, cranelift, gpu)

          Possible values:
          - native:            Native SIR backend (x86-64 direct emission) - No external dependencies - Epistemic-aware register allocation - Thermal degradation modeling
          - selfhosted-native: Self-hosted native backend (produces ELF/Mach-O) - Written in Sounio, not Rust - Produces standalone native executables - Linux x86-64, macOS x86-64/ARM64 support
          - llvm:              LLVM backend (AOT compilation) - Wide architecture support - Mature optimizations
          - cranelift:         Cranelift backend (JIT compilation) - Fast compilation - Good for development/REPL
          - gpu:               GPU backend (PTX emission) - NVIDIA GPU target - Kernel compilation
          
          [default: native]

  -O <OPT_LEVEL>
          Optimization level (0, 1, 2, 3, s, z)
          
          [default: 2]

  -g, --debug
          Generate debug information

      --emit-llvm
          Emit LLVM IR instead of compiling

      --emit-asm
          Emit assembly instead of compiling

      --target <TARGET>
          Target triple (e.g., x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

      --strip
          Strip debug symbols from output

  -v, --verbose
          Verbose output

      --cdylib
          Build as shared library (cdylib) instead of executable

      --alloc-policy <ALLOC_POLICY>
          Register allocation policy for code generation

          Possible values:
          - classic:              Classic register allocation (furthest next use)
          - attention:            Epistemic-aware attention-based allocation (default)
          - attention-calibrated: Attention-based with BO-calibrated weights
          
          [default: attention]

      --attention-config <ATTENTION_CONFIG>
          Path to attention weight configuration file (JSON)

      --emit-alloc-metrics <EMIT_ALLOC_METRICS>
          Path to output allocation metrics (JSON)

      --thermal <THERMAL>
          Thermal model for native backend (none, 7nm, 5nm, conservative)

          Possible values:
          - none:         No thermal modeling
          - 7nm:          7nm FinFET Arrhenius model
          - 5nm:          5nm process model
          - conservative: Conservative model for safety-critical

      --no-thermal
          Disable thermal modeling

      --alloc <ALLOC>
          Allocation strategy for native backend (epistemic, linear, graph)

          Possible values:
          - epistemic: Epistemic-aware allocation (confidence-based spilling)
          - linear:    Standard linear scan
          - graph:     Graph coloring (slower, potentially better)

      --timing
          Show timing information

      --emit <EMIT>
          Emit intermediate stages (comma-separated: ast,sir,asm)

      --target-cpu <TARGET_CPU>
          Target CPU features (comma-separated)

      --enable-cps
          Enable CPS transformation for effect handlers (experimental)

      --glm-enabled
          Enable GLM-4.7 ML-guided optimization (requires --features glm)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
